facts.text: MK is too hungry and cold to sleep at night.
MK looks up at the stars at night.
MK thinks about praying at night.
MK remembers that the gods are scared of Wukong and can't help him.
MK wakes up in the morning as several monkeys throw food into his prison.
MK is starving in the morning.
MK begins to devour everything that the monkeys throw into his prison.
MK briefly wonders whether the monkeys have an ulterior motive.
Wukong comes by later and grabs MK.
Wukong inspects MK and says MK is a bit scrawny.
MK realizes that Wukong probably wants to eat him.

keyphrases: MK realizes Wukong wants to eat him

events.text: MK is too hungry and cold to sleep at night and looks up at the stars while thinking about praying
MK wakes up in the morning as several monkeys throw food into his prison and he devours everything
Wukong comes by later, grabs MK, inspects him, and MK realizes Wukong probably wants to eat him
